**PotentialKits 1.0.0**

A drum kit from your own samples, one tap at a time. The first release of PotentialKits, a PotentialSuite fork of sd88me's [Lucky Dip](https://github.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-luckydip).

- **KIT STYLES:** one tap for a whole kit in a style: CLASSIC, BOOM BAP, LO-FI, TRAP, HOUSE, DUSTY JAZZ, PERCUSSION, ELECTRO or WEIRD.
- **ROLL** with MILD, MEDIUM or WILD.
- **PITCH, DECAY and CHOKE** on every pad, kept in the exported kit: changed pads are saved as you hear them, choke groups become the program's mute groups.
- **USER KITS:** 8 slots that keep the whole kit, for any project.
- **The KIT page:** the 16 pads as tiles laid out like the MPC's own, with the selected pad beside them.
- The PotentialSuite looks (Print Plate, Night Rack, Colour Block) and a **MANUAL** page.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialKits-1.0.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive.
- **`PotentialKits-1.0.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (what MPC TOOLS installs).
- **`PotentialKits-1.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip`** / **`-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: for the Open MPC installer and Plugin Manager (Gen1 / Gen2).

Not yet tested on an MPC: please tell me how it goes. Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialkits/issues/new/choose).
